ck: parasunanitipani upatikantanapraptavayutapeksayanvahan pacehan parkavan ranan tusta yena nipatita 1 cnanatikunasanpurnananokanukrahan kurun vante satyanitin puya tikartacnanasitaye 2 srinacayatirtanuni svayan nankalananustaya sisyan siksayitun krantatO nankalan nipatnan cikirsitan praticanite ranaya ranananiti nanyatve hetunaha kunananikyeti kunasca nanikyani ca tani, nantanan yasyasO tatokta avataranika parasunanitipani ‘asya prakaranasya svapinatapraneyasanartanan, parapinatapraneya-nirasakatvan ca prayocanan’ iti vaktun ‘kin tat svapinatan praneyan, kin tat parapinatan praneyan’ ityakanksanivrtaye acaryapinatan praneyan tavataha paranatnana iti ‘civaparanatnanoratyantapeta nuktiyokyacivanan svatascitananta-tyatnakatvan anatyavityakanakarnaticanya civasya pratiyanana anyatakara tukatyanarta paranarta eva sa ca isvaraprasatanivartya prasatasca isvara-saksatkarasatya saksatkarasca sravanatirupaparoksacnanasatya veta(nta)nan sakalakunakarataya, nisesatosakantaviturataya ca prahna-pratipatakatvan ninansayasca tatupakaranatvan ’ ityetavat acaryapinata-praneyan ata eva ‘veta(nta)nan kunatosapavavisistan prahna visaya prahnanotyantapina saciva atikari tatiyanyatakaranivrti, svarupa-nantavaptisca palan yatayokyan sanpanta ’ ityetatapi acaryapinatan praneyaniti pava etena ‘avityasaptitapavarupacnanasya anatitvepi kanyakarnanastata-pavat upayoranatitvakatananayuktan na ca avityaya svarupenanatitvan, kanyakarnanastu pravahatonatitvan vivaksitaniti vacyan; karnanan tukahetu-tvepi tatkaranapravahapatitanan karnanan karnacanakatvenanyatasitanan anarta-hetutvapavena ‘anatikarnaninita’ ityuktyayokat ’ iti nirastan, anatitvasya avityanatravisesanatvapitanena kanyakarnavisesanatvanapitanat etenEva ‘civakatanyatakaranivrtaye sakalakunakarataya, nisesatosakanta-viturataya ca prahna pratipatayitun asesanaya pravartante’ ityetavatEva acaryapinatavisayatisucanasanpavat sesavEyartyan’ iti parastan nayavatyapinatavisayatinirupanan parasunanitipani tatra ‘visayaticatustayan iha prakarane acaryena sanartyate’ iti tyotanaya sarvapitanasyavasyakatvat parapipretan praneyananuvatati apare tviti ‘civasya paranatnana atyantapeta acnanatininita civasya pratiya-nana tukatyanarta na paranartika Otacnanan tanivartakan vetantasca Otacnanahetava prahnaninansa tatitikartavyatarupa ’ ityetavat parapinatan praneyan ata eva ‘atnEkatvan vetantavisaya acno civa atikari acnananivrtitvara anartanivrti palan yatayokan sanpanta ’ ityapi parapipretan praneyaniti pava nankalacaranan parasunanitipani atit
